annotations.title: Ask Summer a question about the case, such as why it chose a plan or what it found

description: Ask Summer a question about the case, such as why it chose a plan or what it found. Summer reopens its last run on the case, with what it already read, and answers in the case chat. Read-only: it publishes no plan and makes no changes. One question at a time per case. Read cases.chat.list for the answer, which usually takes a minute or two. To change the plan, use investigations.request.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse the same key when retrying the same change
